# Pixel Memory Match

A simple offline memory-match game with 8 pairs of colored cards.

## Features
- 16 cards (8 pairs) with distinct colors
- Flip two cards at a time; matched pairs stay open
- Move counter
- Win message when all pairs are matched
- New Game button to reset
- Keyboard accessible (Tab to focus, Enter/Space to flip)
- Responsive layout (works down to 360px wide)

## How to Play
1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Click or focus + Enter/Space on a card to flip it.
3. Flip two cards; if they match, they stay open.
4. Match all 8 pairs to win.
5. Click **New Game** to restart.

## Run
No build step or server required. Just open `index.html`.

## Files
- `index.html` – structure
- `style.css` – styling
- `script.js` – game logic
